function FindProxyForURL(url, host) {
  var h = host.toLowerCase();
  while(1) {
    var n = h.indexOf(".");
    if (n == -1) break;
    var h = h.substr(n+1);
    if (h in BLOCKLIST) return "PROXY 127.0.0.1:8021";
 }
  return "DIRECT";
}
